name: Stormpike's Order
summary: In Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike sends a shield order south to Stormwind City. He asks you to carry it to Furen Longbeard, the armorsmith he trusts.

sections.title: A Shield Worth the Journey
sections.body: Stormpike trusts no other smith with his shield. He offers good pay to place the commission in Furen Longbeard’s hands, though Stormwind City lies far south of Loch Modan.

sections.title: From Ironforge to the Dwarven District
sections.body:
Stormpike wonders why Furen works so far from Ironforge and the Great Forge, where many dwarves make their home. He suspects Stormwind’s humans pay the smith a king’s ransom.

When the order reaches Furen at his anvil, he takes pride in hearing from the prestigious Stormpike clan. He eagerly prepares to forge the shield.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike is an Alliance sentry stationed in Loch Modan. He belongs to the proud and influential Stormpike clan and serves among the dwarven mountaineers who guard the mountain passes and valleys.
Furen Longbeard is an accomplished dwarven armorsmith who lives in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. His reputation for forging fine shields and armor reaches north to Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why does Furen live in Stormwind instead of Ironforge?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard works in Stormwind's Dwarven District, serving human nobility, city guards, and traveling adventurers. Mountaineer Stormpike wonders why a master dwarf would leave Ironforge, but Furen likely earns a rich income in human coin.

faq.q: What is the Deeprun Tram's role in delivering this order?
faq.answer: Travelers carrying Stormpike's missive usually go west from Loch Modan to Ironforge, then take the Deeprun Tram underground into Stormwind City's Dwarven District, where Furen's forge is located.
Before entrusting you with the delivery to Stormwind, Mountaineer Stormpike tests your mettle and reliability in Loch Modan with 'Mountaineer Stormpike's Task'.

faq.q: Does Furen Longbeard forge the shield immediately?
faq.answer: When Furen Longbeard receives the letter and recognizes the prestige of the Stormpike name, he accepts the commission. He promises to begin hammering out the shield before the end of the day.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see how far a clan's reputation can reach. Stormpike's order also raises the question of why a master armorsmith would choose human stone over Ironforge.
As a blacksmith, you may take note of Furen Longbeard, an exceptional armorsmith known even across kingdoms, as you travel through Stormwind.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see the trade and cultural ties between the dwarven holds of Khaz Modan and Stormwind, joined by the Deeprun Tram.
